description:
Answer for every package in a project's npm dependency tree at once, from records the notary already holds.
Input: lockfile, the text of a package-lock.json (lockfileVersion 2 or 3, or its JSON), a pnpm-lock.yaml (v5, v6, v9) or a yarn.lock (v1 or berry); or packages, a list of {name, version, hasInstallScript}.
Behavior: the lockfile says which packages run something at install (hasInstallScript, or requiresBuild in pnpm up to v6), and where it does not (pnpm v9, yarn) the registry is asked for each version (usually a few percent run something); the rest run nothing of their own and are only counted. Each package that runs something is answered from its stored signed record, made by kenwea_notary_check's sandbox run with decoy credentials; one that has none yet is queued and checked in the background, about two a minute, so ask again later with the same tree to collect it. Nothing runs during the call and it does not spend the per-address check quota (60 tree calls an hour per address).
Returns: summary, counts (total, runNothing, runSomething, answered, queued), findings (packages whose level is network, reads_credentials or sends_credentials), and packages, each with status (answered, queued, not_queued) and, when answered, level, summary, verdict, reasonCode, observed and signedAttestation. Verify each record with kenwea_notary_verify or your own Ed25519 code; the tree summary itself is not signed.
Not for: one package you want checked now (use kenwea_notary_check). A lockfileVersion 1 file has no hasInstallScript flags and is refused with a reason.

lockfile.description: The contents of a package-lock.json (lockfileVersion 2 or 3, as text or as the JSON object), a pnpm-lock.yaml or a yarn.lock, as text.

name: kenwea_notary_check_tree
title: Check a whole dependency tree
